figures.caption: Bactericidal kinetics study. The bactericidal activity of pexiganan (A) and PNPs (B) against H. pylori were monitored for the first 1 h. After 0, 10, 20, and 60 min of exposure time at 37 °C, aliquots were diluted (serial 10-fold dilutions) and plated for CFU counts after 72 h incubation at 37 °C.
figures.label: Figure 1

figures.caption: In vitro development-of-resistance studies. Evolution of MICs after successive exposures of H. pylori to subinhibitory concentrations of the antimicrobial agent. After 15 serial passages, the relative MIC was the normalized ratio of the MIC obtained for a given subculture to the MIC that obtained for first-time exposure.
figures.label: Figure 2

figures.caption: The examination of gastric bioadhesive property. The remaining percentage of pexiganan on the gastric mucosa of rats 2 h (* p < 0.05) and 4 h (** p < 0.01) after oral administration of pexiganan suspension (black bars) and pexiganan nanoparticles (PNPs) (gray bars) (n = 5).
figures.label: Figure 3
